headline: Graph Neural Networks Achieve 99% Accuracy in Real-Time Gesture Recognition via sEMG
reasoning: This paper presents a significant AI breakthrough in real-time gesture recognition using GNNs on sEMG signals, achieving state-of-the-art accuracy (99%) and low latency (48ms). The research is from a credible source (arXiv) and directly addresses a practical application for advanced prostheses and AR, making it highly relevant and technically sound.
summary: Researchers developed a novel graph neural network model for real-time hand gesture recognition using sEMG signals, achieving 99% classification accuracy and a 48ms processing time, outperforming existing methods.

source_articles.title: A Graph Neural Network Model for Real-Time Gesture Recognition Based on sEMG Signals
